subject: Class and category of data items and literals
notes: kb/Work PB1400 LANDED (w1095j). A group explicitly or implicitly described GROUP-USAGE BIT is category and class boolean everywhere it is asked: LENGTH/MOVE/boolean expressions (pb522, pb1400_group_usage_operand_class: GB B-XOR, subordinate GBS B-AND) and now the arithmetic-operand refusal too, whose text was the refuter's residual ('group item GB (class alphanumeric, ISO 8.5)'). ExpressionBinder.NonNumericOperandKind's group and ref-mod arms no longer spell a class; IntrinsicArgumentRules.ClassNameOf derives it from ClassOfPlace (the one 8.5.2.1 classifier): COMPUTE N = GB + 1 / GBS + 1 -> 'group item GB of class boolean (ISO 8.5.2.1)'. ClassSpellingDriftTests pins that no diagnostic spells a class from the enum name.
